title: Ajman Bank marks a major digital transformation milestone with the implementation of the RegTech platform

contentHtml:
Ajman Bank is strengthening its regulatory reporting operations through the adoption of a RegTech solution delivered in partnership with 4most, a specialist credit risk and analytics consultancy, and Reporting Center, a regulatory reporting technology provider. Image courtesy: Ajman Bank

Delivered by 4most and reporting center

Press Release

Ajman, UAE - Ajman Bank is strengthening its regulatory reporting operations through the adoption of a RegTech solution delivered in partnership with 4most, a specialist credit risk and analytics consultancy, and Reporting Center, a regulatory reporting technology provider. The initiative strengthens the Bank’s ability to respond to evolving Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE) requirements through greater automation, centralized reporting and enhanced control.

Mustafa Al Khalfawi, Chief Executive Officer of Ajman Bank, said:

“Regulatory compliance is increasingly about our ability to respond quickly to change while maintaining robust governance and control. By combining Ajman Bank’s institutional strengths with 4most’s market and regulatory reporting expertise and Reporting Center’s RegTech capabilities, we’re building a stronger foundation for technology-enabled compliance.”

The implementation marks an important step in Ajman Bank’s broader efforts to strengthen its regulatory reporting framework through technology and automation.

The implementation brings regulatory reporting activities into a centralized, auditable and customizable environment, providing Ajman Bank with a single platform for managing data collection, regulatory calculations, validations, adjustments and report generation.

By replacing existing reporting activities with structured and automated workflows, the Bank gains greater visibility and control over the entire reporting process — from source data through calculations and validations to the final regulatory submission.

A key element of the transformation is auditability. The platform provides traceability across the reporting lifecycle, allowing the Bank to track data, calculations, adjustments and user actions while providing a clear audit trail to support stronger governance and control.

At the same time, the platform is highly configurable, enabling Ajman Bank to adapt reporting logic, mappings, formulas, validation rules and reporting workflows as regulatory requirements evolve. This provides the Bank with a sustainable reporting infrastructure designed not only for today’s requirements, but also for future regulatory change.

Nicoleta Remmlinger, UAE Director at 4most, said:

“RegTech delivers the greatest value when technology and regulatory expertise work together. Our partnership with Reporting Center brings together deep local market and regulatory reporting knowledge with specialist regulatory technology. Ajman Bank’s commitment to innovation has enabled us to turn that combination into a practical solution for emerging regulatory requirements.”

Elena Unciuleanu, Founder & CEO, Reporting Center, said:

“The collaboration demonstrates a model for the next generation of RegTech: combining specialist regulatory reporting expertise with purpose-built regulatory technology to help banks move from regulatory interpretation to implementation faster and with greater confidence.”

About Ajman Bank

Established in 2007, Ajman Bank PJSC is the first Islamic bank incorporated in the Emirate of Ajman. Headquartered in Ajman, United Arab Emirates, the Bank officially commenced operations in 2009 and is listed on the Dubai Financial Market. Ajman Bank is a key pillar in the Emirate’s economic development strategy and is strongly supported by the Government of Ajman. Ajman Bank offers a comprehensive range of Shari’ah-compliant banking, financing and investment services to individuals, businesses and government entities. Its operations span across Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, Investment Banking and Treasury segments.

About 4most

4most is a specialist credit risk and analytics consultancy supporting financial institutions with expertise across credit risk management, analytics, modelling and regulatory transformation. 

About Reporting Center

Reporting Center is a RegTech provider focused on helping financial institutions digitize and automate regulatory processes, enabling more structured, transparent and efficient management of regulatory requirements.
